A '''Frost Sprite''' was a type of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]. One Frost Sprite, [[Odra]], the "Duchess of Sleet," lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Season Scepter" />

{{Species-stub}}
==Biology and appearance==
Frost Sprites are a sentient humanoid species that inhabit cold places. They have blue skin and yellow eyes along with two arms and two legs. They also have two hands that have five fingers on them.
